old_v1_298_primary_unchanged: Original full-method beetle effort NOT comparable (13-27 Event rows per plot; only 3 common modes, not four); prior full-method biological transfer gate is terminal and must NEVER be declared passed.
specific_new_question: Can a COMMON-METHOD, EQUAL-SAMPLING-OPPORTUNITY subset of co-located Terceira beetle observations, independently selected from source Event metadata, support a cross-taxon woody/beetle spatial-turnover test, without reusing the unequal-effort full beetle response?

fixed_source_frame.exact_site_matching_grammar: Uppercase A-Z/0-9 of original locationID, exact one-to-one ten source sites; secondary coordinate degree difference <=0.0003

method_subsample.eligible_pool: Original samplingProtocol mode string standardized case-fold/whitespace; only modes present in all 10 Terceira sites; NO original species or individual responses examined
method_subsample.selection: Within each original Terceira site and shared method, select exactly the lowest k original Event coreIDs in bytewise lexicographic order, with k the MINIMUM source Event count over 10 sites for that mode; this selects by source ID only, never taxon response. Event timestamp does not rank or select source trials.
method_subsample.method_count_guard: Require EXACT three shared modes; frozen source-only minimum multiplicity multiset [1,1,4], at least 6 events/site; if source differs fail before opening original occurrence
method_subsample.site_count_guard: Ten author Terceira sites and coordinate crosswalk still exact, tree one original Event per site, no year mismatch
method_subsample.acceptance: Pass qualifies only a new prospective ecological metric freeze, never grants v1.298 confirmatory or full-method score. This deliberately constrains beetle detection to a narrower module subset and may miss taxa caught only by other methods.

future_ecological_test_if_eligible.target: Within the identical ten Terceira 50x50m plots, compare source-measured woody-plant and equal-mode-effort beetle assemblage spatial turnover beyond pairwise physical geographic distance.
future_ecological_test_if_eligible.candidate_response: Jaccard plot-pair species dissimilarity in trees and beetles under the locked 60 beetle subevent sample; coreID response seal remains closed until another scientific scoring protocol and tests are frozen.
future_ecological_test_if_eligible.metric_caution: No pseudo-independent 45-pair p-values, no native persistence/rescue or causal plant-to-beetle effect, no other-island replication
future_ecological_test_if_eligible.quality_floor_future: At least 8 source sites with two or more beetle taxa and two or more tree taxa, diverse nonzero Jaccard values and full original source ID/code join. On failure STOP one-shot without data-selected alternative modes.
